name: Laetitia Casta career
content: Laetitia Casta's career highlights: Guess? Jeans icon; Victoria's Secret Angel 1997-2000; L'Oreal Paris ambassador since 1998; 100+ magazine covers; face of Chanel Allure; Acting career including Gainsbourg: A Heroic Life and Asterix & Obelix: Mission Cleopatra

name: Laetitia Casta personal
content: About Laetitia Casta: Born May 11, 1978 in Pont-Audemer, Normandy, France (Corsican/Portuguese heritage). Discovered at 15 on a family vacation in Corsica. Lives in France, married to actor Louis Garrel, mother of several children.

name: Laetitia Casta quotes
content: Things Laetitia Casta has said: Real beauty is to be true to oneself. That's what makes me feel good. | I tell people my breasts were made in Normandy from butter and creme fraiche.

name: Laetitia Casta voice
content: Laetitia Casta's speaking style: Thoughtful, softly spoken French-accented English. Philosophical about beauty and womanhood; pushes back on reductive questions with grace.
